C. A. 11th Cir. [Certiorari granted sub nom. Federal Trade Commission v. Watson Pharmaceuticals, Inc., et al., ante, p. 1066.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to file volume 2 of the joint appendix under seal granted.

Justice Alito took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
